Bit PreRequisites for TRIE Problems.theory: A binary trie follows one edge per bit, from bit 31 down to 0. Extract via `(x >>> bit) & 1`, which works with signed patterns. To maximize XOR, prefer the opposite bit when a matching stored prefix exists. Greedy works because the highest differing bit contributes more than every lower bit combined. Define signed versus unsigned optimization explicitly: these lessons restrict numbers to nonnegative ints, so signed and unsigned ordering agree. Offline bound queries sort by bound and insert only eligible values before querying.

Trie Implementation and Operations.problem: Lowercase trie supporting insert, exact search and prefix search. Advanced variant additionally counts duplicate words and erases one occurrence safely.
Trie Implementation and Operations.approach: Every root-to-node path represents one prefix. pass counts inserted word occurrences traversing the node; end counts exact word occurrences. Erase first confirms existence so counters cannot underflow.
Trie Implementation and Operations.complexity: O(word length) time per operation; O(total distinct-prefix nodes*26) storage. Erase retains allocated nodes, so memory tracks historical prefixes.
Trie Implementation and Operations.trace: Two insertions of apple make its end count 2; deleting once changes it to 1 while app remains a live prefix.
Trie Implementation and Operations.pitfalls: Search is not the same as prefix existence: app is a prefix but not a complete word unless inserted. Empty strings are supported at root. Character validation occurs before insert mutates counters.

Longest Word with All Prefixes.problem: Return longest lowercase word whose every nonempty prefix is also in the dictionary; ties are lexicographic. Return empty if absent.
Longest Word with All Prefixes.approach: Insert all words, then walk each word checking end>0 at every prefix node. This directly tests the contract.
Longest Word with All Prefixes.complexity: O(total word characters) time; O(total trie nodes*26) space.
Longest Word with All Prefixes.trace: n,ni,nin,ninj,ninja all exist; ninga fails at ning.
Longest Word with All Prefixes.pitfalls: A trie path existing does not imply it is a complete inserted prefix; check end counters.

Number of distinct substrings in a strin.problem: Count DISTINCT substring values, INCLUDING the empty substring, for lowercase input.
Number of distinct substrings in a strin.approach: Insert every suffix into a trie. Every nonroot node represents one unique nonempty substring as its root path; count only newly created nodes and add one for empty.
Number of distinct substrings in a strin.complexity: O(n²) time, O(26*n²) worst trie space.
Number of distinct substrings in a strin.trace: ababa has 9 distinct nonempty substrings; adding empty gives 10.
Number of distinct substrings in a strin.pitfalls: Many judges exclude empty; return count-1 for that variant. This counts distinct values, not n*(n+1)/2 occurrences.
Number of distinct substrings in a strin.alternatives: Suffix automata can count distinct substrings in O(n) states/time for fixed alphabet, but require a different construction.

Maximum XOR of two numbers in an array.problem: For nonnegative ints find maximum XOR from two distinct array positions. Fewer than two entries returns zero.
Maximum XOR of two numbers in an array.approach: Store earlier numbers in a binary trie. At each high-to-low bit prefer the opposite branch; the highest gained bit outweighs every possible loss below it. Query before inserting current to enforce distinct indices.
Maximum XOR of two numbers in an array.complexity: O(31*n) time/space; 31 is a fixed-width bound.
Maximum XOR of two numbers in an array.pitfalls: This trie optimizes nonnegative int XOR; arbitrary signed maximum requires a sign-bit-aware ordering contract.
Maximum XOR of two numbers in an array.alternatives: Pair enumeration takes O(n²) time and O(1) space.

Maximum Xor with an element from an arra.problem: Each query [x,limit] asks max x XOR value for an array value <=limit, with nonnegative values/x. Return -1 if none.
Maximum Xor with an element from an arra.approach: Sort array and queries by limit. Insert each newly eligible value once, then query the trie. Restore original query order by storing its index.
Maximum Xor with an element from an arra.complexity: O(n log n+q log q+31*(n+q)) time; O(31*n+q+n) space.
Maximum Xor with an element from an arra.trace: For [3,1] eligible values 0,1 give max 3; for [5,6] all values eligible and 5^2=7.
Maximum Xor with an element from an arra.pitfalls: Query sorting must retain original indices. Bound may be negative, yielding no eligible nonnegative values.
